text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Nnh, grrrrrrgh!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ai-chaaaaaan!!

"‘I want to guide Almond Eye by showing 
her my own heroic figure.’ That desire 
made Fusaichi Pandora stronger day by 
day—"
Then, one day.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Morning! Hey, look at this! It's Ai-chan!

I spotted Almond Eye on the cover of an 
Umamusume specialty magazine.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Great movement, rapid growth, spring in 
her step, driving power. 'Every single one 
is truly remarkable,' says Mr. A, who has 
led many Umamusume to GⅠ victories."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Many Trainers and reporters already know 
her name. To draw this much attention 
before even debuting is truly 
unprecedented."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I can't wait to see how she performs in 
the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, isn't this insane!? Like, is this 
even normal before making your debut!?
choice_data_list: Honestly, that doesn't happen very often.
Honestly, that doesn't happen very often.

text_block_list.text:
To draw this much attention before even 
running an official race. She truly must 
have incredible raw talent.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~~♡ Our Ai-chan really is amazing, 
isn't she?♡ Anyone can see she's just 
bursting with talent♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"If we're already like this, we'll blow 
right past legends and set unprecedented 
records too~!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
She'll definitely get the absolute best 
Trainer, and with world-class training, 
she'll become the strongest in the world 
for sure!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Because Ai-chan is a real genius!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Unlike me!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Aha! I got so excited I bit my 
tongue!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Uryaaaaaaahhhhh--!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (...Sparkle! Sparkle more, and then I'll—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (I will lead Ai-chan—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(...What was I like back when I was 
Ai-chan's age, I wonder?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "...Tra-la-laaa!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Aayyy. Did ya see that? A genius running 
at full throttle♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
......Seriously? Uh, yikes. How can you 
look so smug after that?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait. Yeah, it really is completely 
diff—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Miss Pandora?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ai-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Fancy meeting you here. Doing some 
self-practice? Do you mind if I use this 
spot?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehh, hemlo!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. ...Well then, I'll take my 
leave.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Taah!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible speed. Beautiful form. 
...Dazzling. Too dazzling. It's so bright 
it's getting blurry.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Gleaming and sparkling, even under the 
moon. More than anyone, more than 
anything—the best in the world. So—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(My guidance, huh... Do they even need 
it?)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa, ...? Pandora-san? Aren't 
you going to run—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ... I feel like I'm—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, no, no, it's nothing! It's nothing 
at all! Haha, ahaha!"

The next day. Fusaichi Pandora contacted 
me, saying she needed to take the day off 
from training due to urgent personal 
business.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
………… Ah, this sucks... I just wanna look 
at the sky.
――Hey, little bird What's got you down?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Yeees. Little Birdie is feeling down~.

Those blue, blue days Are when the sun 
comes out――

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
... 'It's precisely when the sky is blue 
that sunny days are ahead.'

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Wait, what? Where is this song 
coming frooom...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ♪ So lift those wings And take to flight――

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: 'Cause blue skies are all right――

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, what a wonderful song after all. The 
message is so warm and gentle.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Oh! So it was Heart-chan and Tact-chan.)

—Daring Tact. A pre-debut Umamusume who 
admires Daring Heart, loves nature, and is 
both tough and gentle.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Um... may I ask what feelings you put into 
making this?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Of course! —taking inspiration from New 
Orleans jazz, naturally!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Whether on joyful days or sad ones, it's 
just there with you, and music flows in 
whenever you listen. Jazz rooted deeply in 
people's daily lives like that—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Lately, I've wanted to be that way too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Oh, really?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My hoofprints weren't ideal. I declared I 
would become queen, and yet the result 
was—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The back I kept clinging to in hopes of 
catching up drifted far away, and 
honestly, it's just been setback after 
setback!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's why I don't want to look 
down anymore. I want to do what only the 
current me can do.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to be someone who can stand by 
broken hearts. To tell them that it's 
okay, even if things didn't go as ideally 
planned."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If I can't be the light guiding your path, 
then I'll be the water that quenches your 
parched throat every morning. Just like 
the jazz in that city that simply lingers 
by your side, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I want to shine—and guide someone forward!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Besides, there's a certain someone I just 
refuse to lose to.

Fusaichi Pandora notified me of an 
unexpected day off, so while I was taking 
care of some other work――

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Sowwy, I'm late.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Can I go for a run right now? I kind of 
feel like... letting loose a bit.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Or rather, this ain't the time to be 
slacking off.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Aha, thank you♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer? Just what if, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
What if... what if I wanted to do 
something for Ai-chan other than just 
guide her?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
What should we say? What can we actually 
say we're capable of?

I wondered what had brought this on so 
suddenly, but the answer came to me right 
away.

Not just guiding them, of course... but 
also how to maintain motivation for 
training and how to keep persevering.

In an actual race, executing your start, 
identifying the critical moment, 
maintaining focus, unleashing your final 
burst of speed—
choice_data_list: Because you're a genius, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha! You're obsessed with your Trainer 
as always!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Believing in it so wholeheartedly, eyes 
sparkling without a trace of doubt... 
Sheesh."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(............ If only I could believe in 
myself the way Trainer believes in me—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Nuh-uh, it's nothing.
